wiki_text: The Expansion/Replacement FSRU was to be Excelerate's newbuild Excelerate Sequoia, swapped in for the original FSRU Exquisite per a Feb 2020 Engro-Excelerate agreement. Pakistan's Cabinet Committee on Energy failed to reach consensus on approving the swap (reported June 2021). Excelerate Sequoia was instead deployed to Brazil, beginning commercial operations at Petrobras's Bahia Regasification Terminal (Salvador, Bahia) on 2021-12-08 -- confirming the Pakistan expansion project has had no dedicated vessel since 2021, consistent with GEM's 'shelved' status.
